items.headline: UCLA into top 5, Ohio State out of top 10, New Mexico earns first AP ranking
items.description: Ohio State dropped out of the top 10 of The Associated Press Top 25 for the first time in five years, UCLA entered the top five for the first time in 25 years, and New Mexico earned the first ranking in program history.
